name: blockstylist eSIM Catalog
author: Louee Gonzales

sections.description:
blockstylist eSIM Catalog allows you to manage a database of eSIM plans and display them using shortcodes. It includes a management dashboard to add, edit, and delete plan details such as destination, price, and data info.

Features:
* Admin dashboard for plan management.
* [querqy_catalog] shortcode to display a grid of destinations.
* [querqy_search] shortcode to display a searchable country dropdown.
* Modal popup for viewing plan details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the blockstylist-esim-catalog folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘eSIM Tool’ in the admin menu to manage your plans.
  4. Add the [querqy_catalog] or [querqy_search] shortcode to any post or page.
